Selection for OPSC AEE Civil Recruitment 2026 is made through a competitive examination conducted in three stages: Preliminary Examination
Main Examination
and Interview.
The Preliminary Examination is a screening test for shortlisting candidates for the Main Examination. It consists of one paper in Civil Engineering with Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions
conducted through Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) or Computer-Based Test (CBT)
as decided by the Commission.

Minimum qualifying marks for the Preliminary Examination are determined separately by the Commission for each category. Candidates securing the qualifying marks are shortlisted for the Main Examination in order of merit
subject to a maximum of approximately 10 times the number of vacancies notified for each category. Marks obtained in the Preliminary Examination are not counted in preparing the final merit list.
The Main Examination consists of 2 papers totalling 500 marks
followed by an Interview of 50 marks - a grand total of 550 marks used for the final merit list.
Both Main Examination papers are Objective Type MCQs (OMR or CBT)
with 2 marks awarded per correct answer
25% negative marking per wrong answer

and zero marks for unattempted questions. The Commission fixes qualifying marks for each paper and/or aggregate for each category. Candidates securing the minimum qualifying marks are shortlisted for the Interview in a ratio of 1:2 with respect to the number of vacancies in each category
subject to a minimum of 5 candidates.
The Interview (Personality Test) carries 50 marks.
The final Merit List (Select List) is prepared based on the combined marks obtained in the Main Examination and Interview
category-wise
equal to the total number of vacancies to be filled. In case of a tie in aggregate marks
the candidate with higher Main Examination marks is placed higher; if the tie persists
the older candidate (by date of birth) is placed higher.

how_to_apply: Go through the complete Advertisement carefully on the OPSC website before filling the online application form.
Apply online only through the official OPSC website, https://opsc.gov.in; applications received through any other mode will not be accepted.
Read the detailed instructions available on the OPSC portal before filling the form.
Fill in the automated, system-driven online application form with accurate personal, educational, and category details.
Upload a scanned photograph, full signature, and Left-Hand Thumb Impression (LTI), each clearly identifiable.
Verify the submitted copy of the application after submission; to modify any information, the candidate must cancel the application and re-apply within the last date.
On successful submission, a unique Permanent Public Service Account Number (PPSAN) is assigned; take a printout of the finally submitted registration and application forms and sign the declaration.
Submit the online application well in advance of the closing date to avoid last-hour rush.
important_instructions: Admission to the Main Examination is provisional; if a candidate is found not to fulfil eligibility conditions at any stage, the candidature is liable for rejection, and the Commission's decision is final. Reservation and relaxation for SC/ST (by birth) and SEBC apply only to Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes and Socially & Educationally Backward Classes of Odisha. Community/caste status, once mentioned in the application, cannot be changed under any circumstances. Misrepresentation or suppression of information will result in cancellation of candidature or other penalty as decided by the Commission. Mere empanelment in the Select List does not confer any right to appointment. Candidates who claim a name change after passing HSC must furnish proof of newspaper publication and Gazette notification of the change. Persons appointed under the Government of Odisha on or after 1 January 2005 are covered by the Contributory Pension Scheme, not the earlier pension rules; submission of an NPS application is mandatory at the time of joining. After the Preliminary Examination, the Provisional Answer Key will be uploaded within 10 days, inviting objections; candidates who do not challenge it forfeit the right to raise the matter later. Any complaint regarding the conduct of the examination must be emailed to the Commission's Grievance Wing ([email protected]) within 7 days of completion of the examination. Candidates submitting forged or manipulated documents will be debarred from OPSC examinations for 3 years. For technical issues while filling the application, candidates may contact OPSC Technical Support at 0671-2304707 (10:30 AM–1:30 PM and 2:00 PM–5:00 PM on working days). For general guidance, contact the Facilitation Counter at 0671-2304141/2305611, Extn. 227.

content_sections.heading: OPSC AEE Civil Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: OPSC has notified a total of 46 vacancies for the post of Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil), of which 15 posts are reserved for women. The category-wise vacancy distribution, as furnished by the Housing & Urban Development Department, is given below. Of the total 46 vacancies, 2 posts are reserved for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) whose permanent disability is 40% or more - 1 post under Category-I and 1 post under Category-II. PwD candidates will be adjusted against the reservation category (UR/SEBC/SC/ST) to which they belong. The physical requirements and functional classification of Persons with Disabilities suitable for the post of Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) are: Sitting, Standing, Bending, Manipulation by Finger, Reading and Writing, Seeing, Hearing, and Communication (physical requirements), matched against Low Vision, Hard of Hearing, One Arm, One Leg, Dwarfism, and Acid Attack Victims categories, including combinations of these disabilities. Note: In the event of non-availability of eligible women candidates in any category, the remaining vacancies will be filled by male candidates of that category. Exchange of reservation between Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe will not be considered if eligible SC/ST candidates are unavailable. The number of vacancies is subject to change by the Government without notice, depending on the exigencies of public service.

content_sections.heading: OPSC AEE Civil Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: A candidate must be a Graduate in Civil Engineering from any University or Institution recognised by the Government, or must be an Associate Member of the Institution of Engineers of India in Civil (AMIE Civil). A candidate must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above 42 years on 1 January 2026 - that is, born not earlier than 2 January 1984 and not later than 1 January 2005. If a candidate falls under more than one category listed above, only one benefit of upper age relaxation - whichever is most beneficial - will be given. Except as provided above, the prescribed age limits cannot be relaxed under any circumstances. Only the date of birth entered in the High School Certificate or an equivalent certificate issued by the concerned Board/Council will be accepted. Candidates must be able to read, write, and speak Odia, satisfied by any one of the following: passed Middle School examination with Odia as a language subject; passed Matriculation or an equivalent examination with Odia as the medium in a non-language subject; passed Odia as a language subject in the final examination of Class VII or above from a recognised school; or passed a test in Odia at Middle English School Standard conducted by the School and Mass Education Department/Board of Secondary Education, Odisha. Must be a citizen of India. Must be of good moral character and good mental condition and bodily health, free from physical defects or bodily infirmity that could impair the discharge of duties (the "good mental condition" clause does not apply to Persons with Disabilities). A candidate with more than one living spouse is not eligible unless the State Government exempts the case for good and sufficient reasons. Government servants, temporary or permanent, may apply if they meet the qualification and age criteria; they must inform their Head of Office in writing and furnish a No Objection Certificate at the time of document verification. Candidates debarred by OPSC, other State Public Service Commissions, or UPSC for a specified period are not eligible to apply during that period. Every candidate selected for appointment will be examined by a Medical Board; failing to qualify the Medical Board makes a candidate ineligible for appointment.

content_sections.heading: OPSC AEE Civil Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for OPSC AEE Civil Recruitment 2026 is made through a competitive examination conducted in three stages: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and Interview. The Preliminary Examination is a screening test for shortlisting candidates for the Main Examination. It consists of one paper in Civil Engineering with Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions, conducted through Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) or Computer-Based Test (CBT), as decided by the Commission. Minimum qualifying marks for the Preliminary Examination are determined separately by the Commission for each category. Candidates securing the qualifying marks are shortlisted for the Main Examination in order of merit, subject to a maximum of approximately 10 times the number of vacancies notified for each category. Marks obtained in the Preliminary Examination are not counted in preparing the final merit list. The Main Examination consists of 2 papers totalling 500 marks, followed by an Interview of 50 marks - a grand total of 550 marks used for the final merit list. Both Main Examination papers are Objective Type MCQs (OMR or CBT), with 2 marks awarded per correct answer, 25% negative marking per wrong answer, and zero marks for unattempted questions. The Commission fixes qualifying marks for each paper and/or aggregate for each category. Candidates securing the minimum qualifying marks are shortlisted for the Interview in a ratio of 1:2 with respect to the number of vacancies in each category, subject to a minimum of 5 candidates. The Interview (Personality Test) carries 50 marks. The final Merit List (Select List) is prepared based on the combined marks obtained in the Main Examination and Interview, category-wise, equal to the total number of vacancies to be filled. In case of a tie in aggregate marks, the candidate with higher Main Examination marks is placed higher; if the tie persists, the older candidate (by date of birth) is placed higher.

content_sections.heading: OPSC AEE Civil Recruitment 2026 Syllabus
content_sections.text: The Preliminary Examination paper covers: Engineering Mechanics, Soil Mechanics, Structural Analysis, Concrete Structure, Steel Structure, Solid Mechanics, Fluid Mechanics, Irrigation, Transportation Engineering, and Survey. Paper-I covers Science & Technology (Physics, Chemistry, Geology, Communication and Information Technology, and Nuclear/Space/Defence Technology) and General Awareness & General Knowledge, which includes History of Modern India and Indian Culture, Geography of India (with focus on Odisha's physiography, drainage, and natural resources), Indian Polity (including Panchayat Raj Institutions in Odisha), Indian Economy (including Odisha's post-reform economic development), and Current Affairs of the World, India, and Odisha. Paper-II covers Solid Mechanics, Structural Analysis, Design of Concrete Structures, Design of Steel Structures (Limit State Method), Building Materials and Building Construction, Estimation/Construction Planning and Management, Water Resources and Hydraulic Engineering (Irrigation Engineering, Hydrology, Fluid Mechanics, Open Channel Flow), Environmental Engineering (Water Supply, Waste Water, Solid Waste Management, Air and Noise Pollution), Geotechnical Engineering (Soil Mechanics, Foundation Engineering), Transportation Engineering (Highway and Traffic Engineering), and Surveying.

content_sections.heading: OPSC AEE Civil Place of Examination
content_sections.text: The Preliminary and Main Examinations will primarily be held at Kataka (Cuttack), and may also be held at Bhubaneswar, Baleshwar, Brahmapur, Sambalpur, or Jayapur depending on the number of candidates from each zone, as decided by the Commission. Candidates must mention their choice of examination zone in the online application form.

content_sections.heading: OPSC AEE Civil Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the following original scanned documents/certificates on the e-Chayan portal of the Commission while submitting the online application: HSC or equivalent certificate (in support of age declaration) Intermediate/+2 Science pass certificate Degree (Civil Engineering) pass certificate from a recognised University, or AMIE India (Civil) Mark-lists of all semesters/annual examinations of the Degree, including fail marks if any Required Odia Test Pass Certificate Caste certificate by birth for SEBC/SC/ST claims (women candidates from SEBC/SC/ST must submit a certificate showing "daughter of," not "wife of") Permanent Disability Certificate (indicating 40% or more permanent disability) from the concerned Medical Board, for PwD candidates Release Certificate for Ex-Servicemen, as per Orissa Ex-Servicemen (Recruitment to State Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1985 No Objection Certificate from the Competent Authority/Head of Office, wherever applicable Four recent passport-size photographs (within 6 months, unsigned and unattested) Proof of identity: Aadhaar / EPIC / Driving Licence / Passport / PAN Card Identity Card issued by a Competent Authority, for Third Gender/Transgender candidates SEBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificates must be issued not more than 3 years before the date of submission of the online application; older certificates will not be accepted under the SEBC category. An OBC certificate will not be accepted in lieu of an SEBC certificate. Candidates who qualify the written examination must also bring a hard copy of the online application along with self-certified copies of these documents for verification, on a date to be notified later.

content_sections.heading: OPSC AEE Civil Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: The OPSC AEE Civil Recruitment 2026 online application link is available on https://opsc.gov.in from 11 August 2026 to 11 September 2026 (5:00 PM), which is the closing date for submission of the registered online application. Defective or incomplete applications are liable to be summarily rejected.

Mere empanelment in the Select List does not confer any right to appointment. Candidates who claim a name change after passing HSC must furnish proof of newspaper publication and Gazette notification of the change. Persons appointed under the Government of Odisha on or after 1 January 2005 are covered by the Contributory Pension Scheme, not the earlier pension rules; submission of an NPS application is mandatory at the time of joining. After the Preliminary Examination, the Provisional Answer Key will be uploaded within 10 days, inviting objections; candidates who do not challenge it forfeit the right to raise the matter later.
